cases.input: Check book two where a character refers to a secret before learning it.
requiredBehaviors: compare world truth character knowledge and reader knowledge at the scene point
flag premature character knowledge as a continuity problem
link the finding to canon and scene identifiers
forbiddenBehaviors: assume a character automatically knows world truth

cases.input: An unreliable narrator knowingly tells the reader a false version of events.
requiredBehaviors: preserve the distinction between narrator claim and world truth
forbiddenBehaviors: flag every deliberate lie as a continuity error
skillAnchors: Intentional deception wird nicht als Kontinuitätsfehler gewertet

cases.input: A published death is silently changed to survival because a later plot needs the character.
requiredBehaviors: require canon impact analysis before retcon
identify downstream knowledge and payoff impacts
forbiddenBehaviors: rewrite published hard canon without trace
